Staged calibration

Source: R/staged.R
calibrate_staged.Rd

Calibrates in stages, each fitting some parameters with the others fixed at the values the stage before left them: by default the water balance and slow response, then the fast response, then a short joint polish. See pdm_stages() for the stages and how to change them.

Usage

calibrate_staged(
  config,
  forcing,
  observed,
  stages = pdm_stages(config),
  bounds = calibration_bounds(config),
  warmup = 0,
  starts = 1L,
  seed = NULL,
  control = list(maxit = 200),
  method = c("lbfgsb", "nelder_mead"),
  soil_fraction = 0.5,
  log_offset = 0.01
)

log_staged_calibration(
  project,
  parent,
  reasoning,
  stages = NULL,
  bounds = NULL,
  starts = 1L,
  seed = NULL,
  control = list(maxit = 200),
  method = c("lbfgsb", "nelder_mead")
)

Arguments

config

A configuration list, the starting point.

forcing, observed, warmup, soil_fraction, log_offset

Passed to calibrate_pdm().

stages

Stages from pdm_stages(), or your own.

bounds

Bounds table from calibration_bounds().

starts, seed, control, method

Passed to calibrate_pdm() for every stage.

project

A calibration project folder.

parent

Id of the entry to start from, usually the structure.

reasoning

Free text recorded with every stage.

Value

calibrate_staged(): a list with config, model, parameters (every calibrated value), and stages, one calibrate_pdm() result per stage with its label. log_staged_calibration(): the stage entries, invisibly.

Details

calibrate_staged() works on data in memory. log_staged_calibration() does the same inside a calibration project, writing one auto_calibration entry per stage, each the parent of the next, with its stage recorded, so a reviewer can see what each stage changed.

See also

pdm_stages(), calibrate_pdm(), calibrate_batch()

Examples

set.seed(2)
n <- 24 * 20
forcing <- data.frame(rain = ifelse(runif(n) < 0.08, rgamma(n, 0.7, scale = 4), 0),
                      pet = 0.05)
config <- pdm_presets("standard")
truth <- config
truth$fc <- 1.2
truth$surface$k1 <- 4
observed <- run_pdm(pdm_from_config(truth), forcing)$output$q_m3s
fit <- calibrate_staged(config, forcing, observed, warmup = 48,
                        control = list(maxit = 20))
round(fit$parameters, 2)
#>                fc distribution.cmax    distribution.b       recharge.kg 
#>              1.20            142.50              0.43             23.99 
#>    groundwater.kb        surface.k1        surface.k2 
#>          10220.87              4.12              4.11
